accessibility.title: NutsNews infrastructure merge updates
accessibility.description: Two July 30 merges select a qualified production VPS image and make promotion-check polling retry documented transient GitHub failures. Operational outcomes are not established by the merges.

review_notes: The bundle documents the two newly supplied merges, plus its existing history, in newest-first order.
PR 451 records the production VPS image selection and rollback reference; PR 452 records bounded retry handling for transient promotion-check reads.
Each entry distinguishes merged changes from unestablished operational results.
No human review is claimed by this manifest.
